correctness.rationale: The polynomial family reduces exactly to \(\dot r=\lambda r(1-r^2)\) and \(\dot\theta=\omega+c(1-r^2)\). The unit circle is hyperbolically attracting because the radial derivative there is \(-2\lambda\). The function \(\Phi_c=\theta-(c/\lambda)\log r\) satisfies \(d\Phi_c/dt=\omega\) identically for \(r>0\), and its on-cycle gradient is \((-\sin\theta,\cos\theta)-(c/\lambda)(\cos\theta,\sin\theta)\). Thus the entire on-cycle state/velocity/phase dataset is parameter-independent while the PRC is not.
risks: The asymptotic phase chart excludes the repelling origin, which is outside the phase basin used for the attracting cycle.
The theorem is about identifiability from on-cycle support, not about numerical performance under additional inductive biases.

originality.rationale: The focal source uses on-cycle differential constraints to learn phase and a PRC, and its data-driven extension argues that zero trajectory loss should recover the underlying vector field. It also acknowledges that transverse Jacobian information is insufficient in limit-cycle samples. The new contribution is an explicit exact family proving that the full PRC and neighboring vector field are mathematically non-identifiable from those data, even noiselessly and continuously. The closest earlier phase-autoencoder work instead trains on off-cycle transients and empirically reports failure when the off-cycle displacement is removed.

value.rationale: The full PRC is the coefficient controlling first-order response to arbitrary weak perturbations, so its transverse component is operationally important. The theorem shows that perfect on-cycle fit cannot certify that component and directly separates data fit from identification. It also gives concrete sufficient remedies: off-cycle trajectories, Jacobian/adjoint information, controlled perturbations, or a justified restrictive model class.
risks: The result constrains universal scientific interpretation of on-cycle-only learning; it does not quantify the empirical error of any particular trained network.
